fusions.name: Drover's Goad
fusions.desc: A prod with the rod that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and drives the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Thundering Herd
fusions.desc: A charge through a cone 6 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Common Pasture
fusions.desc: Opens a pasture where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Horns Turn Outward
fusions.desc: When an enemy strikes you, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
